body:
Project Neev distribution overhaul; OPM 5%→13–15%; younger brands +45%. 61x at 52-wk high; other income 25–30% of PAT; mgmt target only 15% margin. Price single-sourced.
Kill criteria: Revenue growth <20%; OPM <10%; receivable days >35 or GT secondaries falling
Caveat: sourced from public screens — no proprietary edge (lesson L1). Pledges not confirmed from NSE SAST.
